home_title: Tottertop — a one-tap physics tower stacker for your phone
home_desc: Tottertop is a one-tap physics stacking game for phones, now in development. A swaying crane drops blocks onto a wobbling tower; stack it as high as you can. One round takes about a minute.
hero_h1: Drop the block. Keep the tower standing.
hero_lead: Tottertop is a quick physics game for your phone. A crane swings above a wobbling tower: tap once to drop the block and try to stack it so the tower stays balanced. One round takes about a minute.
hero_note: Coming soon. The game is still in development: there is no store page or release date yet, and details may change.
card1_p: Time one tap to drop the block from the swinging crane. No menus, no tutorial walls.
card2_p: See how the tower leans and sways, work out why it wobbles, and plan where the next block goes.
card3_p: Short rounds fit any pause, whether you are waiting for a bus or taking a break.
fact1: Simple physics stacking game, single player.
fact2: One tap to play; a round lasts about one minute.
fact3: Planned as free to play, supported by rewarded ads you choose to watch, with an optional purchase to remove ads.
fact4: Planned for iOS and Android, in 12 languages.
